args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays). This PR upgrades fastjson to 2.9.4, the earliest version that fixes the vulnerability.

Changes:
- requirements.txt: fastjson==2.8.0 → fastjson==2.9.4

CI: passed on branch upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4.
